aboutSection.title: From Isolated Agents to a Coordinated AI Workforce
aboutSection.subtitle: Help AI agents collaborate, share context, and complete complex business tasks together
aboutSection.description: Tego OS is not a loose collection of AI tools. It gives enterprises a governed orchestration layer where multiple agents can reason, collaborate, execute in parallel, and improve over time.

vision.title: How Tego OS differs from traditional AI platforms
paragraphs: From silos to coordination: agents work together instead of operating as disconnected tools
From sequential to parallel: DAG scheduling runs independent tasks at the same time for 2-5x faster execution
From tools to operating layer: LAMP enables agents to reason, communicate, and make decisions as a team

features.description: A Think-Speak-Decide pipeline helps agents reason continuously, share context, and make coordinated decisions, improving task success rates by 15-25%.

architecture.title: v3.0.0 Architecture Overview
architecture.subtitle: Server + Gateway + S3 + Dashboard — four components with clear boundaries at last

legend.server: Server: hub for permission, quota, audit, monitoring, template/runtime governance
legend.gateway: Gateway: instance creation, scheduling, heartbeat, shutdown — shared and per_user share one scheduler
legend.s3: S3: three-layer prefix isolation by template / shared / per-user/{userId}
legend.monitor: Dashboard: aggregation layer deployed independently, cached independently, doesn't impact transactional path

steps.1: Run database migration to 0015: pnpm db:migrate
steps.2: For legacy AI workers, run pnpm db:backfill-template once to explicitly relocate template paths
steps.3: For per_user mode, validate idle recycle / heartbeat fallback / capacity guardrails on a test tenant before canary in production
steps.4: Windows users should switch to the new NSIS installer
steps.5: Private-deployment customers align build process with "build / bundle done externally → only packaged into image"

breaking.1: Removed the legacy avatar_agents table and corresponding API routes — external direct-callers must switch to the new template API
breaking.2: JWT payload adds instanceUserId — clients should re-issue tokens after upgrade
breaking.3: S3 path layout has changed — fallback exists for legacy paths, but explicit relocation is recommended
breaking.4: Gateway template write permission tightened — ordinary user tokens writing template paths return 403
breaking.5: tego-claw Docker image no longer compiles JS internally — private-deployment build flows must adapt
breaking.6: Base image removed Bun / Go / Rust — private plugins relying on in-container compilation must add them back in their own Dockerfile

painPoints.title: Where enterprise AI usually stalls
painPoints.subtitle: TeGo Station unifies identity, data, capabilities, and expertise in one controllable local device.

identity.title: No enterprise identity
identity.problem: AI has no permission boundary or audit trail — compliance is impossible.
identity.answer: → Give AI an identity: RBAC, approvals, and full-path audit.

data.title: Data security risk
data.problem: Business data must leave for the public cloud before AI can help.
data.answer: → Keep data local: platform and business data run on-premises.

scale.title: Hard to scale
scale.problem: AI skills live on personal laptops — hard to share or operate centrally.
scale.answer: → Share capabilities: one governed platform across endpoints.

asset.title: Expertise walks out the door
asset.problem: Expert know-how stays in a few people’s heads.
asset.answer: → Turn experience into assets via Skill Workshop and templates.
